Introduction to Φ-Functions

Speaker: Nikos Yannakakis

Date: Friday, October 9, 2026

Time: 18:30

Location: Conference room, Building E, School of Applied Mathematical and Physical Sciences, NTUA

Abstract

We will discuss about the definition of the Φ-function which arises naturally when studying boundary value problems of variable growth. Then, given a Φ-function we will define the so-called “Generalized Orlicz Space” for which we will investigate certain properties.

References

  1. Orlicz Spaces and Generalized Orlicz Spaces, Petteri Harjulehto , Peter Hästö, 2019
